column1: # allowed_lumensensors.tsv: the complete list of gmpf calls Lumen Sensors (apps/LumenSensors, org.lumen.sensors) may send
# on the X50 (G0111, X50 Ultra, mt9681, stock v1.2.64). Every row is a Call of apps/LumenSensors/src/org/lumen/sensors/
# hal/X50Gmpf.java and every Call a row (rule 6 of tools/devices/check_aidl_hal.py, which the app's test/run.sh runs on
# that file with research/aidl_codes.tsv and devices/goat_elegant/research/banned.tsv: none is BANNED or REVIEW there).
# All are getters with the read-only shape of aidl_codes.tsv (no argument but a sensor index / fan id, a value or an
# out struct back), each one the X50 twin of a read the Z9X app already makes (GmpfAllowlist) and read on the X50 on
# 2026-11-01 (sensors_map.tsv, status verified; raw replies as host test fixtures).
# Stock citations: the X50's own decompiled settings app (builder ~/devices/g0111_mt9681/work/dec/release_838_newsettings,
# com/xgimi/gmpf/api/<Name>.java:<line> = the stock wrapper that reads it; the wire is xgimi/hardware/gmpf/I<Name>$Stub$Proxy
# there). HB lists: devices/goat_elegant/research/allowed.tsv (HbProjector) and allowed_lumeninfo.tsv (LumenInfo).
# NOT here, on purpose: GmFactoryManager 128 getCurHwCurrent (laser currents: BANNED on the HB, R-factory-svc) and
# ProjectorFocusManager 50 getAmbientLight (banned on the Z9X / HB, the path may run the camera): decision pending.
# Also not here: ProjectorFocusManager 46 getTofDistance (an active measurement, not verified on the X50) and
